title: High throughput sequencing of polyA-RNAs in HIV/HCV coinfected patients before and after treatment with with direct-acting antivirals
description: We conducted a prospective study in 33 HIV/HCV-coinfected patients receiving IFN-based therapy at baseline (HIV+/HCV+) and week 36 after the sustained virological response (HIV+/HCV-). Twenty-six HIV-monoinfected patients (HIV+) and 9 patients that achieved the sustained virological response 36 weeks before (HCV-) were included as a control group. The HIV+ patients were effectively treated with cART (virological controlled and CD4+ T-cell counts over 500) for an extended period. RNA-seq analysis was performed on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs).

samples.title: 026C
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral venous blood samples were collected in EDTA tubes. Total RNA was extracted from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells with the RNeasy minikit (Qiagen™), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were synthesize with the Illumina’s TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit v2 using 500 nanogram of total RNA following manufacturer’s protocol.
